_meta.trigger: Scheduled daily at 20:00 local when Smart Link Guard (Pro) blocked ≥1 URL that day. Suppressed on days with zero blocks.
_meta.scheduler: iOS: UNCalendarNotificationTrigger. Android: AlarmManager. Logic: on-device daily tick checks SmartLinkGuardState.todayBlockedCount — fires only if > 0.
